anthropic.title: In Python SDK 1.2.0, TypeScript SDK 0.122.0, Go SDK 1.68.0, Java SDK 2.59.0, Ruby SDK 1.67.0, and C# SDK 12.44.0, `client.beta.files` and `client.beta.skills` no longer send the `files-api-2025-04-14` and `skills-2025-10-02` beta headers and return the same shapes as `client.files` and `client.skills`.
anthropic.summary: 各语言 SDK 的 Files 与 Skills beta 接口完成迁移。

anthropic.title: You can now create **personal keys** and **service account keys** in the Claude Console.
anthropic.summary: Claude Console 新增个人密钥和服务账户密钥。

anthropic.title: The Compliance API session endpoints are out of beta for Cowork and Claude Code sessions.
anthropic.summary: Compliance API 的 Cowork 与 Claude Code 会话端点正式发布。

anthropic.title: The Compliance API local session endpoints now also return transcripts of Claude Science sessions (`product_surface` value `claude_science`) and Claude for Microsoft 365 sessions in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
anthropic.summary: 合规 API 新增 Claude Science 及 Microsoft 365 会话记录。

anthropic.title: The Admin API is now available in the `ant` CLI and the Python, TypeScript, C#, Go, Java, PHP, and Ruby SDKs under `client.beta.organization`.
anthropic.summary: Admin API 已接入 ant CLI 和多语言 SDK。

anthropic.title: We've released **v1.0 of the Python SDK**.
anthropic.summary: Python SDK 1.0 发布，升级 HTTP 层并移除弃用接口。

anthropic.title: The computer use and browser use toolsets (`computer_toolset_20260801` and `browser_toolset_20260801`) are now available on Google Cloud for Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Opus 4.8.
anthropic.summary: Google Cloud 支持多款 Claude 模型的计算机和浏览器工具。

anthropic.title: The computer use tool is out of beta on the Claude API as the `computer_toolset_20260801` toolset.
anthropic.summary: Claude API 的 computer use 工具正式发布。

anthropic.title: We've launched the browser use tool (`browser_toolset_20260801`), a client toolset for driving a browser that your application hosts.
anthropic.summary: 推出可驱动应用托管浏览器的 browser use 工具集。

anthropic.title: Both toolsets are available for Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 on the Claude API.
anthropic.summary: 五款 Claude 模型现可在 API 使用两类浏览工具集。

anthropic.title: The Files API is out of beta on the Claude API.
anthropic.summary: Claude API 的 Files API 正式发布，取消 beta 请求头要求。

anthropic.title: Agent Skills and the Skills API (`/v1/skills`) are out of beta on the Claude API.
anthropic.summary: Agent Skills 与 Skills API 在 Claude API 正式发布。

openai.title: Announced the deprecation of `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.
openai.summary: 四款转录模型将于2027年2月26日停用，Assistants API已关闭。

openai.title: API customers can now select regional processing for an individual request by using a prefixed domain with an API key from a project having Global geography.
openai.summary: API客户现可通过前缀域名为单个请求选择区域处理。

openai.title: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, representing 20% lower input pricing and 33% lower output pricing.
openai.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol输入与输出价格分别下调20%和33%。

openai.title: Released the Prompt Caching dashboard on the OpenAI API platform.
openai.summary: 上线提示缓存仪表板，可查看命中率及各类令牌用量。

openai.title: Transparent backgrounds are now available in preview for `gpt-image-2` and `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` in the Images API and the Responses API image generation tool.
openai.summary: GPT Image 2在图像与Responses API中预览支持透明背景。

openai.title: Announced Ultrafast mode, a new API service tier for GPT-5.6 Sol that runs up to 14x faster than Standard processing.
openai.summary: 公布GPT-5.6 Sol超高速模式，速度最高为标准处理的14倍。

openai.title: Daybreak now offers two access tiers for approved defenders: Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red.
openai.summary: Daybreak推出Blue与Red两档安全模型访问层级。

openai.title: Updated the **chat-latest** snapshot, which points to the latest model available in ChatGPT for Plus and Pro users.
openai.summary: 更新chat-latest快照，指向Plus和Pro用户可用的最新模型。

openai.title: Fast mode now supports long-context requests for GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, and GPT-5.6 Luna.
openai.summary: GPT-5.6系列的Fast模式现支持超过272K令牌的长上下文请求。

openai.title: Customers can now filter and group data by API key in the Usage and Costs dashboards.
openai.summary: 用量与成本仪表板及相关API新增按API密钥筛选和分组。

openai.title: Starting July 30, GPT-5.6 Luna costs 80% less, while GPT-5.6 Terra costs 20% less.
openai.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna降价80%，Terra降价20%，并推出Fast模式。

openai.title: Released the official OpenAI Terraform provider for managing OpenAI API Platform resources as infrastructure as code.
openai.summary: 发布官方Terraform提供程序，以基础设施即代码管理API平台资源。
